source:
@@U00723@@
Just make it something new!

@@U00725@@
We've only recently returned from Spain,
that lovely land of wine and song.

@@U00726@@
(Sings.)

@@U00727@@
There once was a king
Who had a great flea—

@@U00729@@
Ah! Hear that! A flea!
I find a flea’s a fine kind of fellow!

@@U00731@@
(Sings.)

@@U00732@@
There once was a king
Who had a great flea,
He loved him so tender,
Like a son, loved he.
He called for his tailor,
Who came on the run:
“Make jacket and trousers,”
He said, “for my son!”

@@U00734@@
Just remind the tailor his head’s on the block
if the measurement’s wrong or the trousers wrinkle!

@@U00736@@
(Sings.)

@@U00737@@
Sir Flea in satin and
Silk was now dressed,
With ribbons flowing
And a cross on his breast.
At once he was made
A Minister of State,
And all his flea kinsfolk,
Too, grew great.
translation:
@@U00723@@
让它变得新一点吧！

@@U00725@@
我们最近才从西班牙回来，
那片充满美酒和歌声的可爱土地。

@@U00726@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00727@@
从前有一个国王
谁有一只大跳蚤——

@@U00729@@
啊！听听吧！一只跳蚤！
我发现跳蚤是个好人！

@@U00731@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00732@@
从前有一个国王
谁有一只很大的跳蚤，
他如此温柔地爱着他，
就像儿子一样，爱他。
他叫来了他的裁缝，
谁逃跑了：
“做夹克和裤子”
他说：“为了我的儿子！”

@@U00734@@
只要提醒裁缝他的头脑就在街区上
如果测量错误或者裤子皱了！

@@U00736@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00737@@
身着绸缎的跳蚤爵士
丝绸现在已经穿上了衣服，
随着丝带飘逸
他胸前还有一个十字架。
他立刻就被造了
国务大臣，
还有他所有的跳蚤亲戚，
也，长大了。
